name: MX Master
author: vicsvet
description: Battery, DPI and thumb gestures for a Logitech MX Master 3S, spoken to the mouse directly over HID++.

barWidget.description: The mouse's battery on the bar. Left click opens a panel with a DPI slider, the gesture bindings, and whether gestures are armed; right click hides or shows the percentage.

schema.label: Show the percentage
schema.description: Off leaves the mouse icon alone on the bar, which is as quiet as the rest of it. Right-clicking the widget toggles this too.

schema.label: DPI
schema.description: The mouse's own hardware pointer resolution, not the compositor's pointer acceleration. The mouse forgets this whenever it loses power, so this value is what gets put back.

schema.label: Warn at
schema.description: Percent. One notification when the battery first falls past this, and none again until it has charged back above it.

schema.label: Warn urgently at
schema.description: Percent. A second, louder notification, so a warning dismissed while busy gets another chance.
